title: Maximum Trades & Frequency Risk
hook: Risk per trade controls one decision. Maximum trades controls the day.

launchpad.outcome: See how risk per trade multiplies with frequency.
launchpad.missionQuestion: How much can the whole day lose?

slides.title: 1R per trade. Now add trades.

options.label: Per day
options.feedback: They said per trade. Ten trades is up to 10%.

options.label: Per trade, so the day depends on how many they take
options.why: 1% per trade alone doesn’t describe session exposure.

asks.prompt: $100 per trade. 6 full losses. Was “I only risk $100 per trade” a complete daily plan?

options.label: No
options.why: It needs a daily limit and a maximum number of trades.

slides.punch: RISK PER TRADE CONTROLS ONE DECISION. MAXIMUM TRADES CONTROLS THE DAY.

slides.quote: Risk per trade controls one decision. Maximum trades controls the day.

slides.prompt: Why isn’t risk per trade a complete daily plan?
slides.modelAnswer: Because the day’s exposure is risk per trade times the number of trades. Without a daily limit and a maximum number of trades, “1% per trade” can become 10% in a session.

remember: Risk per trade controls one decision. Maximum trades controls the day.
